description.description: Tenant description. Omit to keep the current value or set to null to remove it.

cleanupMode.description: Whether to fully delete or anonymize expired sessions.

ttl.description: JWT TTL for status list tokens in seconds.

immediateUpdate.description: Regenerate status list JWTs immediately after status updates.

enableAggregation.description: Include aggregation_uri in generated status list JWTs.

defaultKeyChains.description: The tenant's key chain per usage type, used where no configuration names one. Replaces the stored entries; omit to keep them, or set to null to remove them.

access.description: ID of the access key chain used where no configuration names one: presentation requests of configurations without accessKeyChainId and the signed issuer metadata. Without it, EUDIPLO picks one of the tenant's access key chains by rule.

anyOf.description: The tenant's key chain per usage type, used where no configuration names one. A usage type without an entry uses a key chain picked by rule.

description: Payload for partially updating tenant metadata.
title: UpdateTenantDto
